recipe.text: I spoke with an ant the other day, but I didn't understand what he said. I guess I'm not so good at talking to animals.
recipe.label: Daha duraksamalı, sosyal açıdan tuhaf hedef

phonemes: aɪ spˈoʊk wɪð ɐn ˈænt ðɪ ˈʌðɚ dˈeɪ, bˌʌt aɪ dˈɪdnt ˌʌndɚstˈænd wʌt hiː sˈɛd. aɪ ɡˈɛs aɪm nˌɑːt sˌoʊ ɡˈʊd æt tˈɔːkɪŋ tʊ ˈænɪməlz.
